card.fires_on: Odd word pieces in the middle of a long word that is split awkwardly, such as 'rog' in nitroglycerin, clopidogrel and androgens, or 'deg' in degmacytes.

modes.label: Inside drug and hormone names
modes.description: The piece 'rog' sits inside names such as nitroglycerin, androgens, antiestrogens and clopidogrel.

modes.label: Other split words
modes.description: Odd pieces in the middle of other long or foreign words, including broken-up text.

card.plain: It fires in the middle of long words that are cut into unusual pieces, most often drug and hormone names.
